description: This is a Swift source file that defines a GatewayConnection actor and related types for managing a WebSocket-based gateway connection in an application. It includes enums, structs, and methods for sending and receiving messages, handling health checks, session management, chat, voice wake triggers, node and device pairing, and cron jobs.

classes.name: GatewayConnection
classes.description: An actor managing a WebSocket connection to a gateway, providing methods for requests, subscriptions, configuration, and various gateway operations such as health checks, chat, skills, sessions, and cron jobs.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request to the gateway with specified method and parameters, handling retries in local or remote modes.

methods.name: requestRaw
methods.description: Performs a raw request to the gateway, returning the raw Data.

methods.name: requestDecoded
methods.description: Performs a request and decodes the response into a specified Decodable type.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Reconfigures the connection with current settings.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Creates an asynchronous stream of GatewayPush updates for notifications.

methods.name: sendAgent
methods.description: Sends a message through the agent channel with specified invocation parameters.

methods.name: healthSnapshot
methods.description: Retrieves the current health snapshot of the gateway.

methods.name: skillsStatus
methods.description: Fetches the status report of available skills.

methods.name: chatHistory
methods.description: Retrieves chat history for a session.
